A1_FL_vs_Centralized.interpretation: FedAvg AUROC=0.795 vs Centralized AUROC=0.799 (delta=-0.004). NI LCB=-0.0045 > -0.02 -> NONINFERIOR. All 5 FL methods non-inferior.

A2_Robust_Aggregation.interpretation: label_flip at f=3 degraded FedAvg AUROC by -0.120 (0.771 vs clean 0.890; 95% CI [-0.178, -0.061]; p=0.0046). coord_median recovered +0.111 (0.882; 95% CI [0.058, 0.165]; p=0.0045). Worst coord_median degradation (sign_flip): -0.012 (near negligible).

A3_Clipped_Gaussian_Perturbation.corrected_sentence: At alpha=0.01, reconstruction cosine similarity decreased by 13.0% relative (0.534 to 0.464) and feature-sign recovery decreased by 12.4 percentage points (80.3% to 67.9%; 15.4% relative), while AUROC decreased by 0.1 percentage points.
A3_Clipped_Gaussian_Perturbation.interpretation: At alpha=0.01 (operating point), AUROC cost=-0.0051 [-0.0201, 0.0098] (within materiality |delta|<0.02; p=0.3926). Reconstruction cosine reduced 13.0% relative (0.534->0.464); feature-sign recovery reduced 12.4 pp (80.3%->67.9%; 15.4% relative). Mechanism described as 'empirical leakage mitigation' NOT differential privacy (no (epsilon,delta)-DP accountant implemented).

A4_Governance_Fault_Detection.interpretation: Signed hash-linked audit log detected 350/350 fault injections (100%) with 0 false alerts. All 7 attack types detected at 100% across all seeds and positions. Note: the log authenticates record provenance and ordering but cannot verify clinical truth of correctly-authorized submissions.

A5_DR_Policy.interpretation: V(uplift, B=0.67)=0.892 vs V(random)=0.860 (delta=+0.032; 95% CI [-0.011, 0.078]); CI includes zero: null uplift confirmed. Incentive improved average attendance over no-incentive (V=0.892 vs no-incentive 0.815), but available baseline predictors could not identify differential responders. Null uplift does not invalidate Phase 5 engineering evaluation.

MIA_Membership_Inference.eicu_interpretation: Attacker at or below chance (CI entirely below 0.5)
MIA_Membership_Inference.cimas_interpretation: Marginal +0.7 pp advantage; statistically detectable but operationally negligible
MIA_Membership_Inference.statement: MIA AUROC was 0.496 (eICU; 95% CI [0.496, 0.498]) and 0.507 (Cimas; 95% CI [0.506, 0.507]). Point estimates are near 0.5; confidence intervals are narrow given N=5 seeds. No substantial membership-inference advantage was detected under the evaluated attack.
